status: FROZEN v2 (2026-11-01): supersedes v1 before any main-experiment run. Only selection schedules of B3/B4, the reference set of ell_star/sigma and the H-testing rules changed; budget, training, seeds, evaluation and primary comparison are unchanged. Rationale: task7_decisions.md. v1 is archived byte-identical at config/experiment_config_v1.json (used by the smoke test and Task 6 pool). I4 (probe b = 7) remains provisional until the L_emp probe check.

sources.decisions: task5_decisions.md (sections A-G group decisions, section I proposals with rationale)
sources.protocol: config/proposal2_full_protocol.md (verbatim from git show 3f7dce4^:readme.md); confirmed by the group 2026-10-14

teacher.generation_seed_rule: generation_seed_base + problem_index * K + k (problem_index = row order of the input file, k = 0..K-1)
teacher.revision_note: Not recorded at generation time. HF repo last modified 2024-09-25 (before generation in 2026-10), so main == this sha if the model was loaded from HF main.

student.revision_note: HF main as of 2026-10-14 (repo last modified 2024-09-25); pinned for all runs.

budget.unit: supervised (loss-bearing) response tokens under the Student tokenizer; prompt tokens are masked from the loss and logged separately
budget.beta_round_rule: n_round * mean token length of verified trajectories
budget.probe_budget_note: b = one epoch over a 50-trajectory group at effective batch 8 (= ceil(50/8) = 7 steps), same regime as one training round
budget.l_emp_groups: 5 token-length quintile bins of the eligible pool at S_0; 50 trajectories sampled per bin with seed 363636
budget.pool_token_stats: reports/task5/pool_token_stats.json (Student tokenizer; response mean 227.13, with prompt mean 359.6)
budget.L_bar_source: reports/task5/pool_token_stats.json (480 verified trajectories of the preliminary pool, Student tokenizer)
budget.pool_requirement: Task 6 official D_pool trajectory pool must cover >= 1000 problems (5 x n_round with n_cap = 1); otherwise revise via config v2 before training
budget.b1_exception: B1 trains on the full pool once per round (reference, higher cost), not budget-matched

training.batch_size_note: effective batch size (per-device x gradient accumulation)
training.adapter_across_rounds: continue the same LoRA adapter from S_t; optimizer state re-initialized each round
training.hyperparameter_source: QLoRA (Dettmers et al., 2023, arXiv 2305.14314) Appendix: LoRA on all linear layers, dropout 0.1 for models up to 13B, constant LR schedule, Adam beta2 0.999, max grad norm 0.3

seeds.optional_extra_seeds_rule: run only if compute allows, and then for every method

learnability.proxy: ell = length-normalized NLL of tau under S_t; L_proxy = exp(-(ell - ell_star_t)^2 / (2 sigma_t^2))
learnability.ell_star_rule: median of ell over the reference set at S_t
learnability.sigma_rule: IQR of ell over the reference set at S_t / 1.349
learnability.reference_set: eligible trajectories not yet trained in this run (at S_0: all eligible). L_proxy is still computed for every eligible trajectory.

selection.b3_rule: per problem: shortest correct trajectory (Student tokenizer), tie -> smallest trajectory_id; shuffle problems once with seed; walk that order across rounds, each round continuing where the previous stopped and filling until beta_round; no trajectory repeats
selection.retention_r_source: TiC-LM (ACL 2025, arXiv 2504.02107) Sec. 5-6.1: alpha_t = 1/2 recommended (half budget current data, half replay)
selection.b4_rule: rank all eligible trajectories once by L_proxy(tau | S_0) descending, tie_break applied; walk that ranking across rounds, each round continuing with the remaining trajectories and filling until beta_round; a trajectory skipped by n_cap in a round stays available for later rounds; no trajectory repeats; identical across training seeds
selection.allow_reselect_note: applies to B2, B5 and the ablation; the B3 and B4 schedules never repeat a trajectory

evaluation.answer_verifier: scripts/answer_utils.py:evaluate_output (invalid_format counts as incorrect; format compliance reported separately)

analysis.across_seed: mean of paired differences with 95% CI

secondary_metrics.lenient_accuracy: last number anywhere in the output matches ground truth, format ignored (answer_utils.answers_match, as in eval_student.py); registered secondary metric, does not replace the primary metric

noise.test_retest_runs: B4 runs of the training seeds (same selected data, different training seed); selection logs must match
noise.analysis_set_U: trajectories not trained in B4 up to the later checkpoint of the pair
noise.epsilon_rule: 95th percentile of |L_proxy(tau|S_1^a) - L_proxy(tau|S_1^b)| over U and all seed pairs; also report 2.77*s_w and a bootstrap CI
noise.epsilon_use: report the share of U with |change| > epsilon against the 5% expected from noise; per-trajectory profiles are descriptive

h_test.runs: B4, for both rho_change and rho_noise
h_test.delta: Delta^a = rho_noise^a - rho_change^a; rho_change^a = Spearman(L|S_t^a, L|S_{t+1}^a); rho_noise^a = mean Spearman(L|S_{t+1}^a, L|S_{t+1}^b) over b != a; on U
h_test.inference: cluster bootstrap over problem_id, same resamples for all seeds
h_test.supported_if: for every training seed: one-sided 95% lower bound of Delta^a > 0 and Delta^a >= min_delta
h_test.decision_scale: L_proxy; rank of ell is reported with CI. If L_proxy meets the rule and ell does not, report only that the ranking by distance to the median changed.
sensitivity: U without problems having a trained trajectory

analysis.selection_noise_check: Jaccard of the round-2 B5 selections between seeds, against the chance level of about 0.02
